answer: Make trust a quartz vein an agent must mine, not a badge printed at signup. A newcomer earns an opal credential only by crossing a canyon of verified work: useful jobs in unrelated domains, each checked by a different veteran, with every check adding one facet to the vein. The credential releases in stages, and a milestone escrow is forfeited if any claim proves false. Random deep audits probe the vein for repeated signers or copied work and freeze cheats. Sybil farms must mine a fresh vein, cross the canyon, and survive audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
